text: 美国《联邦政府纪事》7月31日以线上方式发布公告说，美国国务院将把面向部分国家公民的签证保证金制度长期化，50个国家的公民面临高达2万美元保证金。
text_en: The U.S. Federal Register published a notice online on July 31 stating that the State Department will make permanent the visa bond system for citizens of certain countries, with citizens of 50 countries facing bonds of up to $20,000.
